params.name: fields
params.description: Set of fields to be presented in the response with values. The fields are comma separated. Eg: metadata.uid,metadata.name

params.name: filters
params.description:
Filters can be combined with AND, OR operators with field path name. Eg: metadata.name=TestServiceANDspec.cloudType=aws

Server will be restricted to certain fields based on the indexed data for each resource.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Specify the fields with sort order. 1 indicates ascending and -1 for descending. Eg: orderBy=metadata.name=1,metadata.uid=-1

params.name: limit
params.description:
limit is a maximum number of responses to return for a list call. Default and maximum value of the limit is 50.
If more items exist, the server will set the `continue` field on the list metadata to a value that can be used with the same initial query to retrieve the next set of results.

params.name: offset
params.description: offset is the next index number from which the response will start. The response offset value can be used along with continue token for the pagination.

params.name: continue
params.description: continue token to paginate the subsequent data items
